title: A cash sale
summary: Scan or search items, scan a scale sticker, pay in cash.

steps.say: A weighing-scale sticker adds the item with its weight

steps.caption: Three lines in the cart: two scanned items and a weighed sticker (1.250 kg).

steps.say: Type the cash received and press Add cash

steps.caption: Payment: the cash added and the change to give back.

steps.say: Press Complete sale. The invoice prints.

steps.caption: The sale is done and the invoice printed; the cart is empty for the next customer.

name: 03-cash-sale
